summary: Join our Anti-Corruption and Good Governance Practices Training to empower yourself with essential tools for fostering ethical leadership and accountability.
lede: Anti-corruption training covers how governance, compliance and audit professionals assess bribery exposure and strengthen integrity controls. Participants practice building risk registers, evaluating third-party integrity, designing preventive controls, and triaging speak-up concerns. The course also covers control assurance, governance reporting, and operational use of AI-assisted transaction monitoring with human review for professionals responsible for investigations, high-risk relationships, or governance performance.
audienceIntro: This anti-corruption practices course is designed for professionals who influence integrity controls, investigate concerns, oversee high-risk relationships, or report governance performance. It supports experienced practitioners moving from policy knowledge toward operational programme design.
prerequisites: You should have working experience in compliance, internal audit, governance, procurement, investigations, risk, sustainability reporting, or financial controls. Familiarity with organizational policies and basic risk assessment supports the intermediate-to-advanced exercises. Coding requirement: none. You will use prepared spreadsheet templates and guided dashboard files, so bring a laptop capable of running Microsoft Excel or Power BI Desktop.
